newsitem.title: SWEDEN: BOXING-SWEDISH WORLD CHAMPION ON DRINK-DRIVE CHARGE.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-SWEDISH WORLD CHAMPION ON DRINK-DRIVE CHARGE.

text.p: Sweden's World Boxing Union (WBU) lightweight champion George Scott faces a charge of driving while under the influence of alcohol, police said on Tuesday.

Scott, 29, a naturalised Swede born in Liberia who has spent several years in the U.S., had more than the permitted amount of alcohol in his blood when police stopped his car and tested him in the early hours of Monday, a police spokesman at Vasteras, west of Stockholm said.
